_ownerEmail: Never in this file (public repo). From the 0600 file <secrets dir>/sheila/OWNER_EMAIL.

hostSecrets._why: Sheila's studio joined the shared code on the owner's word, 23 Oct 2026 ("One codebase"): its Worker, D1, R2, domain and keys carried over. Studio email runs on a host Resend sender; everything else is Sheila's own, pasted on Setup or already on the Worker.
hostSecrets._kept: The Worker already carries its YouTube and Google sign-in keys from before the move; secrets never rotates a set one, so these optional sources only matter for a fresh Worker.

whatsNew.title: New in your studio
lines: Your studio now watches your videos before it cuts them, so clips show what really happened.
Each clip says what it thinks it shows. Tap to fix it, no typing.
Camera sound you don't want is left out, and music or a voice over is added.
To keep your accounts safe, you now sign in with a code we email you.
